description: Compatibility rows for kernel (Lean decide) checking at small T, requested by the parent for the formal lane. They are kept separate from certificates/trials.json, whose sha256 is pinned by the parent's independent receipts. Same JSON layout plus an informational key 'u' = max rate (string p/q). Each row satisfies T*exp(-y) <= epsilon/2.
